scenario: X08 known synthetic archive direct-download scope check
method: Each role signed in through the visible login form. Authentication was verified in the same page context with GET /api/submissions -> 200. The known archive download GET then used the page session token in a same-origin in-memory Authorization header; only status was retained and response bodies were cancelled without reading or saving.
positive_control: COL-A previously downloaded this exact archive through the production archive UI; see ui-archive-download-r2.json (HTTP 200, application/zip).
harness_note: An earlier four-role APIRequestContext probe returned 401 because it did not inherit this application’s sessionStorage authentication; one T-B diagnostic fetch had the same issue. These five harness/diagnostic sign-ins are excluded from access results. No archive body was read during those attempts. The authenticated page-context retest above is the evidence.
conclusion: PASS for this known archive ID and these four non-owner roles only; X08 remains partial because attachments, other resource types, and broader list/search paths are not covered.
